title: A3E-DNS manifest envelope
description: The envelope every manifest produced by the extended suite conforms to. Module-specific manifests extend this via allOf and add their own properties.

module.description: The fully-qualified Python module path that produced the manifest.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the JSON payload with this field excluded. The evaluator verifies it; the ingestion helper uses it as the run_id basis.

thesis_reference.description: The thesis claim the manifest supports, in the same shape across all modules.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the manifest was written. Optional; older manifests predating this field are still valid.

seed.description: The RNG seed the producing module used. Required for reproducibility.

config.description: The module's configuration snapshot at the time of the run.
